cases.purpose: Compare repeated ENOSPC results and diagnostics, then verify a complete successful clear in the same shell.
cases.oracle: ncurses clear; setup verifies /dev/full returns ENOSPC.
cases.comparison: Compare statuses, diagnostic files, and recovery bytes with the reference; independently require the full recovery sequence.
cases.script:
clear -T xterm > /dev/full 2> first.err; a=$?
clear -T xterm > /dev/full 2> second.err; b=$?
clear -x -T xterm > recovered.bytes 2> recovery.err; c=$?
printf 'status=%s,%s,%s\n' "$a" "$b" "$c"
printf "first.err="; cat first.err; printf "second.err="; cat second.err; printf "recovery.err="; cat recovery.err
